name: Bruton tyrosine kinase

function.text: BTK encodes Bruton tyrosine kinase, a signaling protein important for B-cell development and transmission of B-cell antigen-receptor signals.

germline.text: Retained constitutional disease associations include Bruton-type agammaglobulinemia (x-linked). Pathogenicity and inheritance depend on the specific allele and disorder.

somatic.text: Acquired BTK mutations are documented in chronic lymphocytic leukemia under BTK-inhibitor selective pressure. This treatment-associated somatic context is distinct from constitutional BTK loss of function causing immunodeficiency.

germline_associations.mechanism: X-linked; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Cohort-level candidate sequence driver in IntOGen (combined q<0.1; at least 3 mutated samples). Statistical association does not classify an individual allele.
Gene-level alteration context supported by primary literature; pathologist review needed.
